description: API foundation for rich analytics: the report query contract + start-event schema, the shared answer-filter helper, range-aware daily series, the public start-event endpoint + recordFormStart service, the full getFormReport upgrade (funnel, completion rates, avg time, section-completeness proxy, range-aware trend, warnings), route wiring, and unit tests for the new pure aggregation helpers. No Prisma migration. Independent of FEAT-002/003 except that they consume this API; build and test it standalone.
steps: In apps/api/src/modules/forms/form.schemas.ts add `trackEventSchema = z.object({ event: z.literal('start') })` and `reportQuerySchema` (from/to as z.string().datetime().optional(); filterQuestionId z.string().min(1).optional(); filterOperator z.enum(['equals','not_equals','contains','not_empty']).optional(); filterValue z.string().max(10_000).optional()) with the two .refine()s from design §2: (a) !(from&&to) || new Date(from) <= new Date(to); (b) all-or-nothing filter — if any of questionId/operator set then both required and value required unless operator==='not_empty'.

In form.service.ts extract `matchesAnswerFilter(answer, operator, value)` preserving matchesJumpRule (~L113) array-aware semantics verbatim, and make matchesJumpRule delegate to it (behavior-preserving).

Generalize getFormDailyTimeSeries(formId, days) (~L3140) to getFormDailyTimeSeries(formId, opts?: { from?: Date; to?: Date }) keeping last-30-days default; add createdAt BETWEEN when a range is passed; zero-fill across the range capped at 366 days with a RANGE_TRUNCATED_SERIES signal when exceeded (design §7).

Add recordFormStart(slug): resolve to a PUBLISHED, not-deleted form (same where as getPublicForm; throw PUBLIC_FORM_NOT_FOUND if absent); fire-and-forget `void prisma.formAnalytics.create({ data: { formId, event: 'start' } }).catch(...)` wrapped so a DB failure never throws to the caller.

Extend getFormReport to (formId, userId, options?) per design §7: add submittedAt + metadata to the response select; apply date range to response where (submittedAt gte/lte) and every formAnalytics.count (createdAt gte/lte); add the start count; apply the cross-question filter in memory via matchesAnswerFilter BEFORE aggregation; compute funnel (views/starts/completions, conversion rates with percentage suppression + filterAffectsCompletionsOnly when a filter is active, starts>views clamp), completionRateViews/completionRateStarts, avgTime {medianSeconds, meanSeconds, sampleSize} over 0 < elapsedSeconds < 86400, sectionCompleteness (multi-section only, reusing isAnswered), peakDay, range-aware timeSeries; validate filterQuestionId against the schema (ignore + warnings:['UNKNOWN_FILTER_QUESTION'] if unknown). Return the superset shape in design §7 preserving totalResponses/analytics/timeSeries/questions.

In form.routes.ts: in GET /:formId/report parse reportQuerySchema.parse(req.query), normalize `to` to end-of-UTC-day (setUTCHours(23,59,59,999)), assemble the typed options (ISO->Date, filter only when all parts present), pass to getFormReport. Add POST /public/:slug/track next to /public/:slug/responses (~L1368): same slug-validation preamble, trackEventSchema.parse(req.body), recordFormStart(slug), res.status(204).end(), errors -> next(error).

Add unit tests mirroring form.service.test.ts for the new pure helpers: matchesAnswerFilter operator semantics (scalar + array), funnel math incl. percentage-suppression-under-filter and starts>views clamp, date-range filtering predicate, section-completeness proxy math, avg-time median/mean/sampleSize with outlier rejection. Export any inlined pure helpers needed for direct import.
acceptance_criteria: `cd apps/api && pnpm exec tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit` exits 0 with no output.
`cd apps/api && pnpm test` passes, including the new aggregation-helper tests.
GET /:formId/report with no query params returns the same four fields it returns today (back-compat), now as a superset.
trackEventSchema rejects any event other than 'start'; POST /public/:slug/track responds 204 and can only ever write event='start'.
No new file under prisma/migrations was created.

findings:
DONE. Verification: `pnpm exec tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit` exit 0; `pnpm test` 64 passed (48 in form.service.test.ts incl. new helper suites). No Prisma migration created.

TRACK ROUTE: POST /api/forms/public/:slug/track, body { event: 'start' } (trackEventSchema, z.literal('start')). Returns 204 No Content on success; unknown/unpublished slug -> next(error) 404 via PUBLIC_FORM_NOT_FOUND. CSRF-exempt by /public/ path convention; already under publicFormLimiter. Service hardcodes event='start' so it can never write any other event.

EXPORTED SERVICE SYMBOLS (import from './form.service.js'): recordFormStart(slug): Promise<void>; matchesAnswerFilter(answer, operator, value) + type AnswerFilterOperator ('equals'|'not_equals'|'contains'|'not_empty'); getFormDailyTimeSeries(formId, opts?: {from?:Date;to?:Date}): Promise<{series: DailyTimeSeriesPoint[]; warnings: string[]}> (DailyTimeSeriesPoint = {date,views,submissions}; default = last 30 UTC days; 366-day cap -> warning 'RANGE_TRUNCATED_SERIES'); getFormReport(formId, userId, options?: GetFormReportOptions) where GetFormReportOptions = {from?:Date; to?:Date; filter?: {questionId:string; operator:AnswerFilterOperator; value?:string}}. Pure helpers also exported: isWithinRange, computeFunnel (type FunnelMetrics), computeAvgTime (type AvgTimeMetrics), computeSectionCompleteness (type SectionCompleteness), computePeakDay.

getFormReport RETURN SHAPE (superset; back-compat fields totalResponses/analytics/timeSeries/questions preserved): {
  totalResponses: number,  // all-time unfiltered count (header eyebrow only)
  analytics: { views, submissions, conversionRate },  // range-scoped views/submissions when a range is set
  funnel: { views, starts, completions, viewToStart: number|null, startToCompletion: number|null, viewToCompletion: number|null, filterAffectsCompletionsOnly: boolean },  // all three rates null when a cross-question filter is active (percentage suppression); null when denominator 0
  metrics: { completionRateViews: number|null, completionRateStarts: number|null, avgTime: { medianSeconds: number|null, meanSeconds: number|null, sampleSize: number }, peakDay: { date, count }|null, sectionCompleteness: Array<{ sectionId, title, percentage }>|null },  // sectionCompleteness null for single-section forms
  range: { from: string|null, to: string|null },  // ISO; `to` is already normalized to end-of-UTC-day by the route
  filterApplied: boolean,
  filter: { questionId, operator, value? }|null,
  warnings: string[],  // 'UNKNOWN_FILTER_QUESTION' (filter ignored), 'RANGE_TRUNCATED_SERIES'
  timeSeries: Array<{ date, views, submissions }>,  // range-aware
  questions: QuestionReport[]  // computed over the FILTERED response set when a filter is active
}.

ROUTE DETAIL: GET /:formId/report parses reportQuerySchema from req.query, normalizes `to` via setUTCHours(23,59,59,999), assembles filter only when questionId+operator present, passes typed options to getFormReport. Cross-question filter applied in memory via matchesAnswerFilter BEFORE aggregation (views/starts stay unfiltered totals). Avg time reads FormResponse.metadata.elapsedSeconds (0 < v < 86400). No submitResponseSchema change (metadata already z.record optional). No Prisma schema/migration change ('start' is a new FormAnalytics.event row value).

FILES CHANGED: apps/api/src/modules/forms/form.schemas.ts, form.service.ts, form.routes.ts, form.service.test.ts.

FOR LATER STEPS (FEAT-002/003 web): web api.get still needs the backward-compatible {signal?} extension in apps/web/src/lib/api.ts; PublicFormPage must POST /api/forms/public/:slug/track once on first interaction and stamp elapsedSeconds into submit metadata; FormReportsPage consumes the superset shape above.
